rules.obligation: Restrict the marketing, distribution or sale of contracts for differences to retail clients
rules.supporting_quote: a limit on the leverage that can be offered on a CFD to a retail client on opening a position, according to the volatility of the underlying
rules.leverage_cap_retail: 30:1 for a CFD on a major currency pair; 20:1 for a CFD on a non-major currency pair, gold or a major index; 10:1 for a CFD on a commodity other than gold or a non-major equity index; 5:1 for a CFD on an individual equity or other reference value not provided for above; 2:1 for a CFD on a cryptocurrency

rules.topic: exemptions for persons benefiting from temporary exemptions or exclusions
rules.obligation: Persons benefiting from temporary exemptions or exclusions must comply with the rules in this section
rules.supporting_quote: Persons (including unauthorised persons) who benefit from a temporary exemption or exclusion from the general prohibition under: (1) Part 7 of the EU Exit Passport Regulations; or (2) Part 4 of the Electronic Commerce and Solvency 2 (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1361) are required to comply with the rules in this section as a consequence of: (3) regulation 59 of the EU Exit Passport Regulations; or (4) regulation 19 of the Electronic Commerce and Solvency 2 (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019.

rules.obligation: Firms must comply with the definition of MiFID investment firm
rules.supporting_quote: Firms are reminded that the Glossary definition of MiFID investment firm includes CRD credit institutions when those institutions are providing an investment service or activity.

rules.obligation: Firms must comply with the definition of marketing and distribution
rules.supporting_quote: Firms are reminded of the prohibitions in relation to the marketing, distribution and sale of cryptoasset derivatives in COBS 22.6.

rules.topic: exemptions for derivative instruments and cryptoasset derivatives
rules.obligation: Firms are exempt from the rules in this section for derivative instruments and cryptoasset derivatives
rules.supporting_quote: The rules in this section do not apply to: (1) derivative instruments for the transfer of credit risk to which article 85(3) of the Regulated Activities Order applies; or (2) cryptoasset derivatives.
